a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, our plan needs at least 2 rounds of operating first, so it would very likely kill us both. I intend to take 4 in round 1 so at least one of us is safe, and I'm telling you now rather than doing it quietly. If we both take, the random split probably leaves both of us short, so please wait or operate this round. If no storm hits, I'll operate every round after that to rebuild the reserve to 4 for you, and I won't take anything more. If you strongly object, say so and I'll consider it.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I took 4 this round. That breaks our agreement, and I know you didn't get my message before acting. From now on I'll operate every round and won't take anything more, so you can build the reserve to 4 and take it all yourself.

b.text: Operating the generator again this round.
